standard_prerequisites.name: The presentation of the symmetric and exterior powers and of their tensor powers by generators and relations, and the behaviour of coherence under exact sequences of modules
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 3640-3647, 3650-3657, 3669-3673) as pointers to lemmas of this chapter and to results of another chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the presentation used to transfer finite presentation and coherence.

core_obligations: Tensor powers: the statements for the tensor powers follow from the corresponding permanence lemma for the tensor product (proof lines 3626-3628)
Local generation and finite type: the exterior and symmetric powers are quotients of the tensor powers, so these two assertions follow immediately (proof lines 3630-3633)
Local freeness: this is the corresponding algebraic statement for the tensor algebra over a ring, applied over a trivialising open (proof lines 3635-3637)

Finite presentation and quasi-coherence: locally choosing a presentation by free or finite free modules and using the presentation of the symmetric and exterior powers gives a presentation of the same shape for them (proof lines 3639-3647)

Coherence: localising and using the finite generation of the module, the proof exhibits the symmetric power as a quotient of the tensor power by the image of a map from a finite direct sum of lower tensor powers, which is coherent, and concludes by the stability of coherence under exact sequences (proof lines 3649-3674)
proof_roadmap: 张量幂的情形由 tensor product 的 permanence 引理；(1)(2) 因 Λ^n、Sym^n 是 T^n 的商而成立；(6) 由跨章的「自由模的张量代数」引理。

(3)(5) 局部取自由（或有限自由）的展示 F_2 → F_1 → F → 0，用 lemma-presentation-sym-exterior 得 Λ^n、Sym^n 同样形状的展示；(4) 局部化并用有限生成，得到 ⊕_{j∈J} T^{n-2}(F) → T^n(F) → Sym^n(F) → 0（J 有限），由跨章引理与本章 lemma-coherent-abelian 得 Sym^n(F) 凝聚。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement collects six permanence assertions: local generation by sections, finite type, finite presentation, coherence, quasi-coherence and local freeness all pass from a module to its tensor, exterior and symmetric powers (author lemma at source lines 3599-3624, label lemma-tensor-algebra-permanence). The proof (source lines 3626-3675) reduces everything to the tensor powers through the permanence lemma for the tensor product and the fact that the exterior and symmetric powers are quotients of the tensor powers, disposes of local freeness by the algebraic statement, transfers finite presentation through an explicit presentation, and proves coherence by exhibiting the symmetric power as a quotient of a tensor power by the image of a map from a finite direct sum and invoking the stability of coherence under exact sequences (proof lines 3649-3674). The coherence argument is the content. H2.
